description: Continue QKV unions after four skip-path reductions
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,635 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 55 prior macro-attempts and 493 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0157/micro-0004 at 1,635/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0157/micro-0005, where pair 422/723 scored 98.97% at 1,634. Six measured sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: four consecutive valid reductions after the preceding exclusion establish remaining local redundancy, so the next minimum-difference eligible QKV groups may compress further despite the latest coordinate-specific failure. One ordered union is added per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than a functional attention change because it exploits a just-replicated parameterization-preserving mechanism.
summary: The next QKV band evaluated three ordered unions. Two qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,635 to 1,633 parameters; the third proposed 1,632, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 2 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used three official migrations/verifications over about 4 minutes.
